title: Turning -ation words into verbs
summary: Take an English -ation noun, drop the -ation and add -er (pronounced like é) and you have a French verb: confirmation → confirmer, celebration → célébrer, participation → participer. This one trick unlocks thousands of sentences.
points: -ation noun → drop -ation, add -er: confirmer, célébrer, participer, visiter.
'to confirm' is two words in English but one in French. Don't translate word for word.
Look for the -ation word even when it isn't what you'd naturally say: 'get involved' → participation → participer.
Even rare English words like 'visitation' tell you the French verb exists: visiter.
un peu (a little): think the n but don't pronounce it. peu has the same vowel as veux.
un peu can sit in the middle: Tu veux participer un peu ?
drills: Do you want to celebrate a little?
I want to celebrate a little.
I want to get involved a little.
Do you want to get involved?
Do you want to get a little involved?
